title: Goldfish waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd45c'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff9a1f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8670a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tail' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6f1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='fin' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcb6b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f2790f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 50 C10 38 6 34 3 30 C8 41 9 45 8 50 C9 55 8 59 3 70 C6 66 10 62 22 50 Z' fill='url(#tail)'/>
  <path d='M20 50 C11 42 7 38 5 35 C9 44 10 47 9 50 C10 53 9 56 5 65 C7 62 11 58 20 50 Z' fill='#ffd98a' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- top fin -->
  <path d='M40 33 C44 22 52 20 58 30 C54 30 52 33 50 37 Z' fill='url(#fin)'/>

  <!-- bottom fin -->
  <path d='M42 66 C45 74 52 75 56 67 C52 67 50 65 49 62 Z' fill='url(#fin)'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='50' rx='30' ry='21' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='19' ry='9' fill='#ffe39b' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- side fins (one waving) -->
  <path d='M46 56 C40 63 35 66 31 63 C35 61 39 60 45 58 Z' fill='url(#fin)'/>
  <path d='M46 44 C38 38 32 37 30 42 C34 42 39 44 45 48 Z' fill='url(#fin)'/>

  <!-- waving hand-fin -->
  <path d='M60 40 C66 32 72 30 76 34 C72 35 68 38 66 42 Z' fill='url(#fin)'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='32' r='3.2' fill='#ffd98a'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='45' r='5.6' fill='#fff7e0'/>
  <circle cx='73.5' cy='45' r='3.2' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='74.6' cy='43.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M80 54 C78 56 76 56 74 55' stroke='#c94f08' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- scales -->
  <path d='M40 44 C44 41 48 41 52 44 C48 47 44 47 40 44 Z' fill='#ffe39b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M46 52 C50 49 54 49 58 52 C54 55 50 55 46 52 Z' fill='#ffe39b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M36 54 C40 51 44 51 48 54 C44 57 40 57 36 54 Z' fill='#ffe39b' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
